README: Optional file overrides for the procedural audio. Drop audio files (ogg/mp3/wav) into public/audio/ and map them here; every entry left empty keeps the built-in WebAudio synthesis. Keys under "music" are bed ids: "cinder" (shrine rooms) and "bellkeeper" (boss chamber); they loop and crossfade over tuning.audio.crossfadeMs. Keys under "sfx" are event names: start, jump, land, attackSwing, attackHit, dash, hurt, death, respawn, enemyHurt, enemyDeath, pickup, dawnCore, gateOpen, breakableBroken, checkpoint, bossTelegraphSweep, bossTelegraphStomp, bossAttack, bossHurt, bossPhase, bossDeath, victory, pause, resume; they play as one-shots. Each value is a path relative to public/audio/, for example "cinder-loop.ogg" or "sfx/dash.mp3". Record every file's source and license in LICENSES.md.
